QuestInfo.name: The Story of Chromile
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart has something to tell you about Chromile, the previous Knight of Light.
QuestInfo.1:
Neinheart has something to tell you about Chromile, the previous Knight of Light.

#b(If there is a problem during the quest, you can forfeit it and start it again.)
QuestInfo.2: Chromile was the previous Knight of Light. The very model of a knight in shining armor, he was loved by everyone... except for the assassin who killed him and his family. Neinheart showed you a photo of him. It's easy to see how the Elder mistook you for his son.
